{{Quote|By the moon of Alderaan... Have Rebel pilots ''not yet'' earned the trust of our commanders?|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Star Wars 12">[[Star Wars (2013) 12|''Star Wars'' (2013) 12]]</ref>}}
The '''moon of Alderaan''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

==History==
During the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]],<ref name="PLD">{{Tales|11|The Princess Leia Diaries}}</ref> a single [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="TEA" /> a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]].<ref name="Core">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> At night, the light cast by the moon lit up the planet's surface, providing illumination for [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]] [[Thranta Rider|riders]]<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> including a young [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of Alderaan.<ref name="PLD" />

Some time after [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]],<ref name="Date">According to "[[The Princess Leia Diaries]]," the moon of Alderaan was intact shortly after [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] twelfth birthday. As ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates her birth to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], this occurred in [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]].</ref> the moon was shattered, its remains orbiting the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|field]] known as [[the Graveyard]] created by the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]]<ref name="TEA" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> which was mistaken for a moon in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] by the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] shortly after the disaster.<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode IV: ''A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>

Later, the moon would be invoked by Leia Organa in an utterance of frustration towards her [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] superior [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].<ref name="Star Wars 12" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Although, according to the atlas, Alderaan had no moons.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="ANHn" />}}
Though the [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] indicates that Alderaan did not have a moon,<ref name="ANHn" /> [[1995]]'s ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> and [[2002]]'s "[[The Princess Leia Diaries]]" depicted a moon over the planet.<ref name="PLD" /> In [[2003]], the [[Wizards of the Coast]] roleplaying supplement ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' stated both that Alderaan had no moons, and that the moon's remains orbited the Graveyard. [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' reaffirmed that Alderaan possessed a moon, as did the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''<ref name="Deceived" /> and [[2013]] comic [[Star Wars (2013) 12|''Star Wars'' 12]].<ref name="Star Wars 12" />
